title: NCT 127 Bringing ‘NCT 127 5th TOUR ‘NEO CITY : SEOUL – THE REDLINE’ in CINEMAS’ to Screens Around the World
summary: The special event will open in theaters on Sept. 20.
contentText:
K-pop supergroup NCT 127 is coming to your area. Specifically, your local movie theater with the upcoming global live cinema event NCT 127 TOUR ‘NEO CITY : SEOUL — THE REDLINE’ in CINEMAS , a special screening that will bring the group’s fifth world tour kickoff show to movie theaters around the world on Sept. 20.

The concert will be broadcast live from Seoul’s Olympic Park KSPO Dome, capturing the finale of the group’s three-night kickoff performance on their fifth world tour. The concerts will mark the “Kick It” combo’s return to the stage after a nearly two-year hiatus from touring, and will include a reunion of fans with charter members TAEYONG and JAEHYUN, who were not part of the band’s previous tour due to their compulsory South Korean military service stints.

“We look forward to bringing NCT 127’s highly anticipated return to touring to cinemas worldwide,” said Trafalgar Releasing CEO Marc Allenby in a statement. “This marks our fourth project with the NCT brand and our first release specifically centered on NCT 127, making this a significant moment for Trafalgar and fans around the world. This live cinema event gives NCTzens globally the opportunity to experience their fifth world tour together on the big screen.”

The concerts are part of a yearlong celebration of NCT 127’s 10th anniversary and will follow on the heels of the upcoming (Aug. 24) release of their seventh full-length album, BLINGY . Tickets for the screenings will go on sale on Aug. 27 at 10 a.m. ET; for local screening times, participating theaters and full ticket details click here .
